You can create a hit sitcom, but the plots of some episodes are based exactly off of your most embarrassing moments, and everyone knows it. Would you do it? What would the show be about?

Sure. The big secret to happiness is learning how to just let things hang out. Embrace the stupid and cringeworthy moments, and they stop bothering you.

So my show would be full of flashbacks that tie in to my behavior today. It'll illustrate how we never really change in this world. First episode would start with a flashback. It's the late eighties. I'm 18 and I have a regrettable New Wave haircut. It's a dingy apartment. Punk posters on the walls. Empty cans of beer everywhere. An overflowing ashtray sitting beside me. I'm sitting on the couch, tears flowing down my face, badly playing a guitar and singing about how much I miss this girl. Terribly overwrought lyrics. I mean, really terrible. As the song ends, I say "Kelly, someday we'll be together again."

Cut to present day. I'm semi-respectable middle aged man. Having coffee with my friend.

"Guess who contacted me on Facebook?"

"That woman you were drunkenly hitting on in the bar last night?"

"You know, I don't think I'll be hearing from her again. I don't think she liked it when she showed me her cat pictures and I started talking about brain parasites in litter boxes. No. It was a girl I was engaged to back when I was a teenager. Turns out, she's still looking incredible and she's single!"

The rest of the episode will be about dating an old flame. Great chance to flash back to the dumb things I did dating as a young man, and contrasting that to the dumb things I still do as an older guy. The episode will end with me in the car as an old man, singing the same stupid song the teenage me did at the start of the episode.

That's the pilot. It's Larry David meets the Young Ones. Somebody can call my agent if they decide to place an order.
